mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (blog_id, board_id, parent_post_id, writer_user_id, title, content) VALUES (#{blogId}, #{boardId}, #{parentPostId}, #{writerUserId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS writer_nickname FROM post p LEFT JOIN blog_user u ON p.writer_user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS writer_nickname FROM post p LEFT JOIN blog_user u ON p.writer_user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.board_id = #{boardId} AND p.parent_post_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.post_id DESC
SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS writer_nickname FROM post p LEFT JOIN blog_user u ON p.writer_user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.parent_post_id = #{parentPostId} ORDER BY p.post_id ASC
